components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact, sharp, and type-led. Used for decisive actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 14px 34px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(98% 0 0); background: oklch(10% 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(10% 0 0); border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.16s ease, background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: oklch(60% 0.25 350); border-color: oklch(60% 0.25 350); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(60% 0.25 350 / 0.22); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Command Pill
components.description: A calm pill for command names and install affordances.
components.css: .ds-command-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 11px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(10% 0 0); background: oklch(96% 0.005 350); border: 1px solid oklch(92% 0 0); border-radius: 99px; }

components.name: Code Chip
components.css: .ds-code-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 7px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.76rem; color: oklch(52% 0.25 350); background: oklch(60% 0.25 350 / 0.15); border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: A framed artifact for repeated command or demo items.
components.html:

Final alignment, spacing, and micro-detail pass before shipping.
components.css: .ds-card { width: min(260px, 100%); padding: 20px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; background: oklch(98% 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(92% 0 0); border-radius: 8px; transition: transform 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.10); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.92rem; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: oklch(25% 0 0); font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Thin editorial navigation with a serif brand mark.
components.html: / ImpeccableSkillsVisual mode
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; background: oklch(98% 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(92% 0 0); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-brand { margin-right: auto; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.12rem; color: oklch(10% 0 0); } .ds-nav a { color: oklch(25% 0 0); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a.active { color: oklch(60% 0.25 350); }

narrative.overview: Impeccable uses an editorial, high-contrast visual system: paper, ink, considered serif display type, precise sans-serif body text, and a single assertive magenta accent. The product critiques generic AI aesthetics, so expression comes from type scale, spacing, confident hierarchy, and concrete examples rather than decorative noise.
keyCharacteristics: Paper, ink, and one decisive magenta accent.
Typography and spacing carry most of the personality.
Category colors stay scoped to command and detector group navigation.
Surfaces stay flat until state or intent earns elevation.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Editorial Magenta is the only assertive accent. Category colors stay in command navigation and detector taxonomy.

rules.name: The Type-Led Rule
rules.body: Brand expression comes from display/body/mono contrast, not from decorative containers.

rules.name: The Flat Until Earned Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat by default. Shadows appear only for overlays, hovered artifacts, or intentional specimen framing.

dos: Do let typography and spacing provide most of the personality.
Do use the magenta accent sparingly and deliberately.
Do keep examples concrete: show the command, the before state, and the improved state.
donts: Don't use purple-blue hero gradients, glassmorphism, bokeh blobs, or neon tool-marketing tropes.
Don't bury Codex command syntax behind generic product copy.
Don't add decorative cards where a clean section or list would be clearer.
